summary: Iteration 7 (4 new features) fully verified. BACKEND: 74/74 tests pass (47 iter1-6 regression + 27 new iter7). New tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iter7.py cover: multi savings-goals CRUD w/ validation (empty name/target<=0 → 400, PUT/DELETE unknown → 404), POST /api/goals/{id}/contribute (amount<=0 → 400, unknown 404, response has {goal,transaction,user} with goal.saved incremented, transaction.type=expense/description=goal.name/category='Savings', user.custom_categories auto-contains Savings/expense, /transactions returns the tx), POST /api/categories/hide (dedupe, hiding 'Other' → 400 case-insensitive, invalid type → 400, empty name → 400, returned in /auth/me), PUT /user/settings language (fr/es/en persist, xx → 400). Stale iter6 goal tests using removed /users/goal endpoints were rewritten (see updated /app/backend/tests/test_iter6.py — TestGoal class removed, TestSalaryHistory.test_me_returns_salary_history_and_new_fields now asserts 'goal' NOT on /auth/me and language/hidden_categories ARE, TestZRestoreCanonicalState.test_restore_goal_trip_to_japan now uses /api/goals). FRONTEND (390x844 web preview, token via localStorage sm_session_token + add_init_script, get_by_text('...').last for tab labels): (a) SAVINGS TAB — 4th tab visible, savings-total shows €150.00 (Trip to Japan seed), goal-card 'Trip to Japan €150.00 of €5,000.00 · 3%' progress bar; add-goal-fab opens goal-sheet, filling goal-name-input='TEST_NewCar' + goal-target-input='2000' + goal-save-button (clicked via evaluate to bypass modal-off-viewport) creates goal (visible as savings-goal-{id}); contribute-button-{id} opens contribute-sheet, contribute-amount-input='50' + contribute-confirm-button increments saved to €50.00 in card; Activity tab shows SAVINGS group card with 'TEST_NewCar -€50.00' AND 'Trip to Japan -€150.00' entries; edit-goal-{id} opens sheet with goal-delete-button — after delete, savings-goal-{id} removed from Savings tab AND Activity STILL shows TEST_NewCar tx (past transactions preserved). (b) CATEGORY DELETE via long-press (dispatched via PointerEvent+MouseEvent down/up with 700ms hold, since Playwright mouse.click(delay=...) does not trigger react-native-web's onLongPress) — Long-press category-chip-Leisure (preset) → chip disappears (hidden per-user); long-press category-chip-Gym (custom) → deleted (chip disappears); long-press category-chip-Other → no-op (chip remains). After long-pressing selected category-chip-Food, the chip is removed and selection resets (per code, category='Other'). Re-adding Gym via category-add-chip + new-category-input + new-category-save restores it. (c) LANGUAGE — Settings shows Language section with language-en/language-fr/language-es. Tapping language-fr → entire UI switches: Settings→Réglages, tabs Accueil/Activité/Épargne/Réglages, Activity month bar tick 'juin/juil./août', 'août 2026' header, Salaire/Revenus/Dépenses labels; language-es → Ajustes, Inicio, Actividad, Ahorros, Moneda, Idioma, Datos, Restablecer datos, Exportar CSV, Cerrar sesión; language-en → back to Settings/Home. Language persists after reload (localStorage token + user.language in DB). (d) CSV EXPORT — Settings > export-csv-button triggers browser download (page.on('download') fires); intercepted URL.createObjectURL captured blob content: 3 sections present TRANSACTIONS (Date,Type,Category,Description,Amount,Currency — 8 rows incl 2 Savings), SALARY (Month,Salary), SAVINGS GOALS (Name,Target,Saved — 'Trip to Japan,5000,150'). Zero console errors during export. REGRESSION (all green): add-transaction from fab creates TEST_regression_tx (visible in Activity); template-chip-{id} for 'Coffee' present; share-month-{key} fires window.print (called 2x — expo-print's Print.printAsync on web internally invokes it twice, not a code bug); year-overview-button navigates to /year, year-title '2026', totals INCOME +€200/EXPENSES -€350/SAVED €10,350, cells JUN €3405/JUL €3670/AUG €3275; year-back-button returns to Activity. Home donut renders with Savings slice visible (green wedge). Deprecated console warnings still present (non-blocking, iter-3/4 carryover): 'transform-origin' from react-native-svg <G origin>, 'props.pointerEvents' from CategoryDonut. critical_code_review_comments: server.py /goals endpoints: POST validates name.strip() non-empty and target>0 (400); GET sorts by created_at asc; PUT/DELETE return 404 when goal not owned by user; goal_public strips user_id and _id. Correct isolation via {'id':goal_id, 'user_id':user['user_id']}.

server.py POST /goals/{id}/contribute: validates amount>0 (400), returns 404 for unknown goal; auto-provisions 'Savings' expense category on user.custom_categories if missing (case-insensitive check); pulls 'Savings' out of hidden_categories if user had hidden it (so the auto-created Savings shows in the chip list); logs an expense tx with description=goal.name, category='Savings'; $inc saves absolute value; response returns {goal, transaction, user} with user_id stripped from tx. Correct atomicity except: not wrapped in a transaction — if $inc after insert_one fails, the tx is orphaned; acceptable given single-doc mongo semantics and low risk.
server.py POST /categories/hide: type validated ∈ {expense, income}, name required, blocks 'Other' (case-insensitive), dedupes on {name,type}. Correct.
server.py PUT /user/settings language: validates ∈ {en, fr, es}, only writes non-None fields. user_public returns language default 'en'. Correct.
server.py: OLD /users/goal PUT/DELETE endpoints correctly removed. user_public no longer exposes 'goal' — /auth/me now returns hidden_categories, language, salary_history alongside custom_categories.
AppContext.contributeToGoal correctly updates local state atomically from server response (goal, transaction prepended to txs, user replaced) — no race between goal.saved and tx list.
TransactionSheet.chips memo re-computes when hidden_categories or custom_categories change; onLongPress on chip 'Other' is undefined (guarded via c.name !== 'Other') — correct.
TransactionSheet.removeChip: after removing selected chip, resets category state to 'Other' via `if (category === c.name) setCategory('Other')` — correct.
exportCsv.ts on web uses Blob + createObjectURL + a.click + revokeObjectURL pattern — correct download flow, no memory leak.
AppContext.setLanguage delegates to patchSettings which optimistically updates local user then confirms with server response. Correct.

i18n index.ts has full en/fr/es dicts for 60+ keys covering tabs, screens, sheets, alerts. Only ONE missing key: 'balance_trend' — Activity screen shows English 'BALANCE TREND' literal even under fr/es.

IMPORTANT ITER-7 GOTCHAS: (1) React-Native-Web's Pressable onLongPress does NOT fire on Playwright's page.mouse.click(delay=...) or page.mouse.down/up with move. Must dispatch PointerEvent + MouseEvent 'down' → sleep 700ms → 'up' via page.evaluate. See /app/test_reports/iteration_5.json rca_of_issue for the exact snippet. (2) SheetModal on 390x844 pushes save buttons slightly below viewport (Playwright throws 'Element is outside of the viewport'); use `page.evaluate('document.querySelector(...).click()')` to bypass viewport check. (3) Tab labels can repeat in page content (e.g. 'Savings' appears both as tab label and as category name / group header); use `page.get_by_text('Savings').last.click(force=True)` to target the tab. (4) test_iter6.py had TestGoal class using /users/goal — REMOVED in iter7, replaced with test_iter7.py::TestGoals + TestGoalContribute. TestSalaryHistory.test_me_returns_salary_history_and_new_fields now also asserts 'goal' is NOT on /auth/me and 'language' + 'hidden_categories' ARE. TestZRestoreCanonicalState.test_restore_goal_trip_to_japan now uses /api/goals collection, not user.goal. (5) After running full backend suite, run `cd /app/backend && python tests/seed_multi_month.py` to restore canonical 6 tx state (TestZDeleteAccount wipes them), then re-contribute 150 to Trip to Japan goal (or accept goal saved=150 with no matching tx). (6) 'Savings' custom category is auto-created by the /goals/{id}/contribute endpoint — /auth/me will contain it after any contribution. Removing 'Savings' via long-press is possible (custom category) but will break donut coloring for existing Savings txs.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs found in iter-7 scope. Long-press testing on react-native-web required dispatching PointerEvent+MouseEvent instead of using Playwright's mouse.down/up (which don't map to react-native-web's Pressable long-press detection). Snippet: `await page.evaluate(async ({testid, ms}) => { const el = document.querySelector('[data-testid="'+testid+'"]'); const rect=el.getBoundingClientRect(); const x=rect.left+rect.width/2, y=rect.top+rect.height/2; const opts={bubbles:true,cancelable:true,composed:true,clientX:x,clientY:y,button:0,pointerId:1,pointerType:'touch'}; el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',opts)); el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mousedown',opts)); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms)); el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',opts)); el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('mouseup',opts)); }, {testid, ms:700})`.
